persons.name: Kālidāsa
persons.evidence: śrīkālidāsana saṃcaya yāṅā || umeśaprītaye tantraṃ kālīdāsena saṃcitaṃ

notes: Kālidāsa is the compiler (saṃcaya yāṅā / saṃcitaṃ) of this collection of Tantra chapters. Bhavānīśaṅkara / Umeśa refers to the deity Śiva/Bhavānīśaṅkara to whom the compilation was dedicated.
